verdict.rationale: Dropbox's developer resources include an article on 'Customizing scopes in the OAuth app authorization flow' and an OAuth guide. That indicates first-party scoped OAuth credentials an agent could use, but the evidence is only page titles with no detail on scope granularity or least-privilege practice. Viewer/editor sharing permissions are a different feature and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented list and granularity of OAuth scopes, detail on issuing or revoking per-app or per-agent tokens, agent-specific guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
